{{ModeTabs|Story}} ==Cutscene== [[File:Hardcore Cutscene 1 Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
A field of statues, one larger than the others is shown while a lullaby can be heard. This is followed by multiple shots of [[Wretched Front]], [[Outskirts Commune]] and the statues as the song continues. The lullaby ends shortly after a figure on the large statue stops picking a flower and later casts a spell. Once the spell is cast, the statues around the area shatter, freeing the [[Void Knight]]s stuck inside of them. The large statue also starts to break, though it takes it far longer to do so. The freed [[Void Knight]]s then begin walking through the [[Wretched Front]] as the gates in it opens.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:VoidcoreOpening.ogg|300px]]
''A field of stone statues and one large statue is visible, with dust moving in the air. The camera zooms in on the large statue's face, showing that it has been turned to stone. The camera again shifts to show a fallen statue. The camera changes to show the large statue's face once more.'' {{Color|VoidCaster}}: *Humming* {{Color|VoidCaster}}: Dormant, in the depths. ''The camera shows a visual of [[Wretched Front]], changing various times to different views.'' {{Color|VoidCaster}}: You found my hand chilled to the bone. ''The camera shows a visual of [[Outskirts Commune]], changing various times to different views.'' {{Color|VoidCaster}}: My tears I hold, your warmth now so cold. ''The camera once again shifts to show the statues.'' {{Color|VoidCaster}}: Close your eyes my knights. ''The view shifts to reveal the mysterious figure, singing a lullaby while picking a flower, before opening a book and raising a staff.'' {{Color|VoidCaster}}: Remember when the world was bright. {{Color|VoidCaster}}: Dream my brave souls... {{Color|VoidCaster}}: Dream the DAYS OF OLD! {{Color|VoidCaster}}: It seems it's no longer a dream at all {{Color|VoidCaster}}: Arise... ''The statues smash apart with a spell the figure seemingly casts from her book, revealing [[Void Knight]]s within.'' {{Color|VoidCaster}}: When there is creation, there is the void. And soon... {{Color|VoidCaster}}: ALL will find comfort in it. As we have. ''The next shot is a close up of the mysterious figure, before revealing the central statue shaking, to signal that whatever is within is free.'' {{Color|VoidCaster}}: *Laughter* ''The screen shows [[Void Knight]]s rushing out of the entrance of [[Wretched Front]].''
